verdict.rationale: Ledgy is a SaaS equity-management platform, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions data residency, hosting regions, or region selection. The 'global' references (cross-border mobility reporting, payouts in 170 countries) are about workforce and payments, not where customer data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
